        set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_port_burden value = 2 } set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_port_review value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_port_review_due days = 180 } set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_port_pending_event value = 1025 }
    }
    option = {

        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_shu.1024.reduce_burden.consequence_tooltip }

    }
}
